title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential: The final expression for the electric field at point P must be correctly derived as E = kQ/r².

title: Superposition at midpoint
description: Essential: The final expression for the electric field at point C must be correctly derived as E_C = k(q₁ + q₂)/a².

title: Charge magnitude comparison
description: Important: Based on the field line diagram, the student must correctly conclude that q₁ > q₂.

title: Nozzle velocity expression
description: Essential: The final expression for the water velocity from a single nozzle must be correctly derived as v₁ = Q₁/(4πr²).

title: Superposed velocity expression
description: Essential: The final expression for the water velocity at point C with both sources must be correctly derived as v₂ = (Q₁ + Q₂)/(4πa²).

title: Vector superposition principle
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply vector superposition for both the electric field and the water velocity fields.

title: Analogy recognition
description: Optional: The solution may explicitly note the analogy between electric field lines and incompressible fluid flow lines.

title: Sign error in superposition
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly subtracts contributions at point C (e.g., E_C = k(q₁ - q₂)/a²) instead of adding them.

title: Incorrect geometric factor
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses an incorrect area (e.g., 4πr instead of 4πr²) in the fluid flow expressions.
